positive_snippets:
"A good review is one which is not requested by hosts to be posted." Will be posting an honest feedback.

- Had a great stay for a couple of weeks.
Rooms 9/10
Service 9/10 (Special credits to Mr Param who has been a great host and is always there to help)
Food 9.5/10
Laundry 6/10 (They've already started working on the feedback, hopefully will be 9/10 soon)
Value for money - 9/10
*Overall 9/10*

This is places one of the finest places in Gurgaon for your weekend stay.
Rooms are clean and the staff is exceptional.
The rooms were serviced on time and my stay of 28 days was seamless and grateful.

The dinner buffet and the breakfast option is good enough to keep you satiated and not miss delicious food.

I strongly recommend you to plan your next stay here.

I stayed there for at least a month and it was a very good experience. The food, the house keeping and the services they provide everything were excellent. Especially our manager Mr. Rohit he was very coordinating and guided me every time whenever i need any help. It was first time staying outside my home but due to rohit sir I didn’t really miss my home because he provided me everything i want. Thanks Rohit sir and team
